area: Collector console / KPI tiles / period labels
title: "Resolved today" counts a rolling 24 hours, not today: at 14:40 IST it includes cases closed yesterday afternoon
repro: Read code (server check pending): the daily tile label is period1(c) ? "Resolved today" ...; its number is kpiBlock's rc query over scopeWhere(s, now, true) = periodSinceWindow -> `closedAt > (now - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)`.
root_cause: The label was written for a calendar day; the window is a rolling 24 h from the console's now.

title: PDF report cover says "District-wide" when the numbers are filtered to a taluk or a category
repro: Set a taluk (map) or a category (chart) filter with no zone, Export report > PDF. The request carries &taluk=/&cat= (Overlays.tsx q()), the server filters every figure (report() -> overview(..., focus)), but buildReport is given scope: c.zoneName ?? "District-wide" and dept only.
root_cause: The scope words passed to the PDF were not extended when the taluk and category cross-filters were added.

title: Map legend counts every incident in scope per layer, but at most 150 pins are drawn and '<N> not on the map' counts only the unplaced ones
repro: GET /api/collector/overview?period=weekly: compare map.pins.length with map.layerCounts sum
root_cause: pins are capped at 150 server-side (and again client-side) while the legend and the 'not on the map' button are computed over the whole scope

area: Overview tiles vs severity card / PDF

where: src/lib/collector/intel.ts:731-733 (ongoing per incident) vs :876-879 (severity counts per CLUSTER); Overview.tsx:68; Attention.tsx:24; reportPdf.ts:116

title: News complaints handed to a department count as open in some figures and not in others
repro: With dept_assignments rows in scope: compare kpi.cur.ongoing with zoneTable open sum + zoneUnassigned.open and with insights briefing.stats.open. Not run: the 3106 server was not reached before the time box ended; read from code only.

title: The bell ignores zone, taluk and category filters, and files everything older than an hour under 'Earlier today' even in a 90-day view
repro: Set zone 9 and open the bell: rows from other zones; switch to Quarterly: weeks-old items under 'Earlier today'. Not run: the 3106 server was not reached before the time box ended; read from code only.

area: Public tracking after a Collector decision
title: A Collector 'reopen' on a case that was never closed, or even accepted, is saved. The petitioner's /track then says 'In Progress: The department is working on it' two seconds after filing
repro: node tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/hunt2-desk/p16.mjs (files a GCC-ELE petition, collector POSTs {decision:'reopen'} on its new case, then tracks it)
root_cause: The decisions route takes 'reopen' for any open case. progressOf turns every reopen into 'In Progress' without checking that there was a close or resolve to undo.
where: src/app/api/collector/decisions/route.ts:57 (reopen needs no confirmation and no closed state); src/lib/complaint-progress.ts:77-79 (reopen always adds 'In Progress')

area: Public tracking after a Collector decision
title: When the Collector uses 'Mark resolved' on a case with no work done or reported, the petitioner reads 'Verified by Collector: The Collector's office checked the work and closed the complaint'
repro: node tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/hunt2-desk/p20.mjs (files a GCC-ELE petition; the collector resolves its case two seconds later, step-up confirmed with the test account; then tracks; then reopens and tracks)
root_cause: progressOf maps 'resolve' to the same public status and wording as 'verify'. The Collector route allows 'verify' only for severe work, but 'resolve' for any case.
where: src/lib/complaint-progress.ts:74-76 (resolve and verify both become 'Verified by Collector'); src/lib/manu/track.ts:46
